prompt.en: how did wukong sneak into the cave?
prompt.zh: 悟空是如何溜进洞穴的？

answer_evidence.quote: "I'll sneak into his cave and look around. Maybe I can find out how he created the fire, smoke, and sand."
Wukong turned into a bug and flew back to the demon's mountain.
He went into the cave and flew down a long, dark tunnel.

prompt.en: why did the demon take off the bells?
prompt.zh: 为什么恶魔摘掉了铃铛？

answer_evidence.quote: He plucked a few of his hairs and turned them into fleas.
The fleas landed on the demon's neck and began biting.
The demon scratched at his neck and rolled over.
Then he scratched some more—and more.
"Why is my neck so itchy?" he said.
"Maybe it's these bells. I'll take them off while I sleep."

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

prompt.en: what did wukong put on the table?
prompt.zh: 悟空把什么放在桌子上？

answer_evidence.quote: The demon laid the three bells on a table.
The fleas turned back into hairs and returned to Wukong.
Next the monkey turned the hairs into three fake bells.
He put them on the table and stuck the real bells in his robe.
